_description: Extruder-7 (seeded demo asset) vibration in ISO 10816 zone D — Mira opens the case; Rex's failure-probability severity floor clamps RUL into the 24h window and the safety-critical hard-stop forces engineer review; Wanda plans an emergency work order and the parts gate holds (bearing 72h lead > RUL) so it routes to the reliability engineer, not the issuer.
